title: Indian Street Food
description: India's streets are the greatest food adventure on Earth — pav bhaji, samosas, pani puri and endless masala chai. #indianfood #streetfood #india #foodie

scenes.text: India's streets are the greatest food adventure on Earth.
Sizzling pav bhaji on a hot iron griddle.
Crispy golden samosas straight from the pan.
Pani puri that explodes with flavor in a single bite.
And sweet, milky masala chai on every corner.
In India, the best food isn't in restaurants. It's on the streets.
